args:
Fix the style carousel layout in OnboardingStyle.tsx to 
  match the mobile-first design in onboarding/5.1Onboarding-Style.png:

  1. Card sizing - Change card dimensions to be taller and narrower (mobile-optimized):
     - Change card width from flex-[0_0_280px] to flex-[0_0_240px] or similar
     - Increase card height from h-80 to h-[420px] or auto to accommodate taller images
     - Change image container from h-48 to h-64 or h-72 to show full character/outfit

  2. Image display - The style card images are portrait-oriented showing full outfits. Ensure:
     - Image container is taller to show the full character (not cropped)
     - Keep object-cover but increase height significantly
     - The image should be the dominant element of the card

  3. Card peek effect - Ensure the carousel shows partial next card:
     - Add padding to the carousel container so cards don't touch the edges
     - The rightmost visible card should be partially cut off to hint at more content
     - Use px-4 or px-6 on the carousel wrapper

  4. Reduce text spacing - Make the text section more compact:
     - Reduce margin between image and title (mb-4 to mb-2)
     - Keep title and description close together
     - Overall card should emphasize the image over text

  5. Mobile responsive - This is primarily a mobile view:
     - Consider max-w-md or similar constraint on the carousel container
     - Cards should feel large and immersive on mobile screens
